name: Moonwell (Ashenvale)
summary: In central Ashenvale, the Moonwell of Purity rests east of Iris Lake and west of Raynewood Retreat. Its waters carry Elune's grace to nourish the forest and cleanse foulness from the land. Alliance travelers following Raene Wolfrunner's research seek Shael'dryn beside its basin.

sections.title: Sanctuary of Purity
sections.body: Beneath central Ashenvale's canopy, this moonwell is a sacred place for the kaldorei. Its shining waters draw on nature's magic and the light of Elune. Satyr corruption, fel taint, and logging harm the surrounding forest. Shrines of pure water are vital to those working to heal the woods.

sections.title: Healing the Wood
sections.body: Alliance travelers following Raene Wolfrunner's research come here to find Shael'dryn. She knows of the rod Dartol once made and points them toward its scattered pieces. Once the pieces are recovered, she reconstructs the rod at the moonwell.

faq.q: What is this specific moonwell called?
faq.answer: This site is called the Moonwell of Purity. It lies east of Iris Lake and west of Raynewood Retreat, one of several moonwells across Ashenvale.

Moonwells are sacred basins consecrated to Elune, where lunar power mingles with natural magic. Night elves use them to sustain the land, renew their spiritual strength, and purify items tainted by dark or demonic influences.

faq.q: Why do Alliance adventurers visit this moonwell?
faq.answer: Alliance travelers following Raene Wolfrunner's research from Astranaar come here to seek Shael'dryn. She helps them recover the scattered pieces of Dartol's rod.

angles.text: As a night elf, you know each moonwell as a sacred home away from home. It holds Elune's grace and helps guard Ashenvale from demonic taint.
As a tailor, you can use the moonwell's lunar power to weave pure Mooncloth from felcloth.
